meta.title: AJ Management — Corporate events & experiences
meta.description: We plan, produce and run corporate events designed around people, brands and business goals.

hero.body: From concept to execution, we plan, produce and run corporate events designed around people, brands and business goals.

what.body1: AJ Management is an independent agency specialised in planning, producing, coordinating and delivering corporate events and experiences.
what.body2: We work as an extension of our clients' teams, handling every stage: from the first idea and venue selection to production, suppliers, logistics and on-site operations.

items.title: Corporate Events
items.body: Conventions, company meetings, presentations and corporate gatherings.

items.title: Executive Experiences
items.body: Kick-offs, leadership meetings, forums and executive events.

items.title: Team Experiences
items.body: Team-building events, celebrations, recognition programmes and employee experiences.

items.title: Event Production
items.body: Creative development, audiovisual production, staging, lighting, furniture and technical coordination.

items.title: Logistics & Operations
items.body: Guest management, transport, run-of-show, accreditation, suppliers and on-site coordination.

items.title: Venues & Suppliers
items.body: Venue sourcing, negotiation, catering, entertainment and specialist supplier management.

projects.lead: Every project is different. Our approach stays the same: understand the goal, build the right team and execute every detail.

universal.title: Bringing ~global~ brands to [life]
universal.body: AJ Management works on projects that turn globally recognised entertainment properties into experiences and productions that matter to the local market.
universal.videoLabel: Walk-through of the Universal pop-up, Mexico City

planeta.title: We ~build~ experiences around [stories]
planeta.tags: Corporate Events · Launches · Production · Guest Experience
planeta.body: AJ Management works with Grupo Planeta to develop and produce events that connect authors, media, partners and audiences through carefully designed experiences.

privalia.title: A [partnership] built over ~time~
privalia.body: A long-term relationship built on consistent execution, operational trust and an understanding of the client's changing needs.

y2019.name: eFashion Day
y2019.body: Talks, networking and a lunch for hundreds of guests in a courtyard turned into a stage. From set-up to the last table, in a single day.

y2020.name: eFashion Day Live
y2020.body: When nobody could gather, the event became a live broadcast: its own set, remote speakers and full technical production.

beauty.name: Privalia Beauty Week × Glamour
beauty.body: A beauty week with Glamour at Brick Hotel in Mexico City: brand spaces, make-up stations and content captured live for social.

live.name: Hugo Boss × Privalia
live.body: Live shopping production for Hugo Boss on Privalia Mexico, covered by GQ Mexico & Latin America.

mendel.title: Corporate [experiences] designed around ~people~
mendel.body: From planning and supplier coordination to production and on-site operations, AJ Management built a corporate experience designed to bring the Mendel community together.

process.title: One ~point~ of contact from [start] to finish

steps.name: Brief
steps.body: We understand goals, audience, timing and budget.

steps.name: Concept
steps.body: We design the experience and define the venue and production approach.

steps.name: Planning
steps.body: We coordinate suppliers, logistics, timelines and technical production.

steps.name: Wrap-up
steps.body: Load-out, operational close, report and follow-up.

about.body1: Founded in Mexico, AJ Management creates and produces events and experiences for companies and brands across markets.
about.body2: Our network of producers, venues, technical partners and specialist suppliers lets us build the right team for every project, with one central point of coordination.

contact.title: Have an [event] in ~mind~?
contact.body: Whether it's a corporate meeting, an executive experience, a convention or a large-scale event, we'd love to hear about your project.
contact.whatsappMessage: Hi Alfred, I saw the AJ Management portfolio and would like to talk about an event.

footer.privacy: This page uses no cookies. We only count visits anonymously and in aggregate; we don't identify anyone.
